fields.description: Warm-up: the scheduled sync job (budget_mis.api.erp_actuals_sync.refresh_actuals_data) or the one-time backfill (erp_actuals_backfill.run_backfill) refreshing an ERP Actuals Data record on its own normal schedule. Manual Sync: an admin's own "Sync Now" button click on one ERP Actuals Data record (erp_actuals_data.js / erp_actuals_backfill.sync_now). Fetch: reserved for any future direct report-triggered fetch - reports currently read ERP Actuals Data only, with no live-ERP fallback, so this value is not produced by anything today.
fields.label: Call Type

fields.description: Every current caller (erp_actuals_backfill.refresh_period) always logs "Miss (fetched)" - a real PeopleSoft HTTP call ran every time, since this doctype's own refresh is never served from a cache. Hit/Skipped remain as options only for compatibility with older log entries written before this doctype-based architecture (when a Redis-cached live fetch and a login warm-up job could produce them) - nothing produces them today.
fields.label: Cache Result

fields.description: Wall-clock time for this call, in milliseconds. Near-zero for a cache hit; up to ~120000 (120s) for a cold PeopleSoft fetch.
fields.label: Duration (ms)

fields.description: The function this call came through, e.g. erp_actuals_backfill.refresh_period.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Not populated by anything today - kept for compatibility with older log entries written before this doctype-based architecture, when a Warm-up entry's own App Module Setting gating populated this.
fields.label: Modules

fields.description: The user whose action caused this call (log_call() always sets this to frappe.session.user) - the scheduled sync job's own background-job user for a Warm-up entry, or the admin who clicked "Sync Now" for a Manual Sync entry.
fields.label: Triggered By
